name: smart-shopping-platform
description: Smart Shopping Price Intelligence Platform - monorepo (web, mobile, API, shared contracts)

scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @smart-shopping/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @smart-shopping/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @smart-shopping/api && npm run build --workspace @smart-shopping/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
